_isolation:
; writes: only its own folders and the temp area (the allow after this wins)
(deny file-write* (subpath "/"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "/fake/services/proj") (subpath "/fake/workspace/proj") (subpath "/fake/allow") (subpath "/fake/tmp") (subpath "/fake/var/folders") (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/zero") (literal "/dev/random") (literal "/dev/urandom") (literal "/dev/stdout") (literal "/dev/stderr") (literal "/dev/tty") (literal "/dev/dtracehelper"))
; the files its sessions load settings and hooks from: never written, wherever they are made
(deny file-write* (regex #"/\.tool(/|$)") (regex #"/TOOL\.md$"))
; the runtime's own folder in the project, and in each of its worktrees: nothing in it written but what it names writable
(deny file-write* (require-all (subpath "/fake/workspace/proj/.tool") (require-not (subpath "/fake/workspace/proj/.tool/worktrees"))))
(deny file-write* (require-all (regex #"^/fake/workspace/proj/\.tool/worktrees/[^/]+/\.tool(/|$)") (require-not (regex #"^/fake/workspace/proj/\.tool/worktrees/[^/]+/\.tool/worktrees(/|$)"))))
; reads: other projects, services, platform state, credentials, Keychain files; its own folders allowed again
(deny file-read* (subpath "/fake/workspace") (subpath "/fake/services") (subpath "/fake/workspace/other") (subpath "/fake/git-origin/other-memory.git") (subpath "/fake/home/.ssh") (subpath "/fake/hub/.state") (subpath "/fake/hub/.state/bus") (subpath "/fake/home/Library/Keychains") (subpath "/fake/hub/.logs") (regex #"^/fake/memory\-copies/[^/]+/memory(/|$)") (subpath "/fake/secrets") (literal "/fake/home/.netrc"))
(allow file-read* (subpath "/fake/services/proj") (subpath "/fake/workspace/proj") (subpath "/fake/allow") (subpath "/fake/hub/.shared"))
; the folders above them: stat only (resolving a path to its own folder walks through them)
(allow file-read-metadata (literal "/") (literal "/fake") (literal "/fake/hub") (literal "/fake/services") (literal "/fake/workspace"))
; the raw devices of disks and attached images: their blocks would bypass every read deny above
(deny file-read* file-write* (regex #"^/dev/r?disk[0-9]"))
; the Keychain system services
(deny mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.SecurityServer") (global-name "com.apple.securityd.xpc") (global-name "com.apple.security.agent") (global-name "com.apple.security.keychain-circle-notification") (global-name "com.apple.secd") (global-name "com.apple.trustd.agent"))
; no mounts: none made, remounted or unmounted by the process, none asked of the services that mount, attach disk images or change disks, nor of the disk-image driver (LaunchServices: the lsopen deny below)
(deny file-mount)
(deny file-mount-update)
(deny file-unmount)
(deny mach-lookup (global-name-prefix "com.apple.DiskArbitration.") (global-name-prefix "com.apple.diskimage") (global-name-prefix "com.apple.system.hdiejectd") (global-name-prefix "com.apple.storagekitd") (global-name-prefix "com.apple.filesystems.") (global-name-prefix "com.apple.fskit.") (global-name-prefix "com.apple.netauth.") (global-name-prefix "com.apple.automountd") (global-name "com.apple.diskimagescontroller"))
(deny iokit-open-service (iokit-registry-entry-class "IOHDIXController") (iokit-registry-entry-class "AppleDiskImagesController"))
(deny iokit-open-user-client (iokit-user-client-class "IOHDIXControllerUserClient"))
; no asking other system services to launch programs outside the sandbox, no touching other processes
(deny lsopen)
(deny appleevent-send)
(deny process-exec (literal "/usr/bin/open") (literal "/usr/bin/osascript") (literal "/bin/launchctl") (literal "/usr/bin/crontab") (literal "/usr/bin/at") (literal "/usr/bin/batch") (literal "/usr/bin/security"))
(deny process-info*)
(allow process-info* (target same-sandbox))
(deny signal)
(allow signal (target same-sandbox))
